name: Sirca Paints India Ltd
title: Sirca Paints India Ltd - 543686 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue +33% and FY26 EBITDA margin 20.08% (vs 18.05%), but Sirca is pushing 2 price hikes (~10%) to offset crude-linked RM spikes, and working capital is stretched (inventory and debtors up).

utilisation.quote: we are expecting that by the end of this year, the capacities will be, you know, utilized, fully in single shift of the Unit 1

capex.quote: for FY27, we are not, actually, expecting very big Capex. We are only expecting a 5 to 6 odd crore CAPEX

triggers.label: Import inventory down ~15-20 cr
triggers.quote: we are expecting almost 15-20 crores inventory going down from here

triggers.label: Two price hikes, ~10% on Sirca
triggers.quote: 2 price increases, combining to almost 10% on the whole range of Sirca products

triggers.label: Italy imports replaced by India production (95%)
triggers.quote: 95% of the products that we used to import from Italy will now be produced in India

triggers.label: Sirca Unit 1 full in single shift by year-end
triggers.quote: we are expecting that by the end of this year, the capacities will be, you know, utilized, fully in single shift

triggers.label: NC raw material shortage hits Wembley
triggers.quote: we are still facing pressures from the supplier, because it is a product which also go in defense

guidance.quote: we are looking at a growth of almost 25-30% based on, you know, CAGR growth
the EBITDA margins should remain in the category of, say, 19-21%
we are sorted to, you know, reach to a turnover of about 250 to 300 crores
if not 5% we are expecting, should be near 3-4%
We are only expecting a 5 to 6 odd crore CAPEX

red_flags.label: Working capital ~2x Asian Paints; inventory and debtors up
red_flags.quote: If I compare our working capital with our peers, like Asian Paints. It's almost twice as high.

red_flags.label: Wembley revenue flat; Rs 4-5 cr lost to NC raw material shortage
red_flags.quote: we almost lost orders of 4 to 5 crores in March from Wembley

red_flags.label: Pre-acquisition channel loading inflated FY25 base
red_flags.quote: they had almost 5-6 crore sale that they did additional before the transition

evasions.quote: by the end of this year, it has completed. So, in the coming quarter, we are expecting both the inventory and also the debtors to come down
the final EBITDA would still come down more or less at the same level
